Nora White: Heads-up: ran into a reproducible bundler + types mismatch that breaks auth in edge builds for our JS SDK. Vite + Rollup both exhibited it.

Nora White: Repro (very small):
1) create a Vite TS app
2) npm i redwood-inference-sdk@canary
3) src/handler.ts: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` then `const client = Redwood.createClient({ apiKey: DUMMY })`
4) vite build -> deploy to Cloudflare Pages Functions

Nora White: Result: requests show 401/unauthenticated and client console shows repeated `no auth header, retrying`. Works in node dev server but fails after rollup optimizations.

Diego R.: Likely ESM/CJS export shape mismatch. Bundle analysis?

Nora White: Built chunk shows `exports.createClient = ...` but no default export object. So `import Redwood from ...` becomes undefined.

Priya S: Classic interop footgun. Quick app fixes: use `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` or `import * as Redwood from ...; const c = (Redwood.default||Redwood).createClient(...)`.

Diego R.: SDK-side fixes: emit both named exports and a default object in the ESM and CJS bundles. For CJS add `module.exports = exports.default || exports` at end of bundle. For ESM re-export named plus a default object. Also update .d.ts to include both styles so TypeScript editors don't show wrong types.

Nora White: There's an auth/retry nuance: when createClient is missing, the client code treats the network error as transient and retries aggressively. On edge platforms this wastes invocation time. We should short-circuit retries on 401/403 in edge contexts and surface a clear hint about bundler interop.

Priya S: Agreed. I'll draft PR that: (1) normalizes exports, (2) updates typings, (3) disables retry-on-401 for runtime flagged as edge, (4) updates quickstart to prefer named imports.

release-bot: Opened issue #4871 and linked PR #4120 (status: in review).

Diego R.: After patch, smoke-tested on Netlify Edge and Cloudflare Workers. Default import cases now work, and the noisy retries stopped. Also added a short DevEx note explaining the `import * as` fallback and Vite config snippets for `commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules`.

Nora White: Will add the tiny repro repo to the issue and update sample apps. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
